details.title: Democracy, Business Climate & Artificial Intelligence
details.description:
The 2026 theme is part of a key moment for Gabon, which is committed to institutional and economic reforms designed to strengthen stability, transparency, and confidence.

International experiences show that the quality of governance and the predictability of institutions are decisive factors in attracting investment.

By linking democracy, the business climate, and technological innovation, the Forum highlights the levers capable of durably transforming African economies and restoring long-term trust with international partners.

header.sousTitre: Reconciling democratic stability and economic performance to build Gabon's future.

presentation.description:
Inaugurated in 2026 (over 3000 seats), the Omar Bongo Ondimba Convention Center stands as a modern infrastructure.

Built in the heart of the Cité de la Démocratie, it reflects the vision of H.E. Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema.
